Coaching Workshop for Leaders and Managers

Designed to create real impact at work, our coaching workshop equips leaders and managers with a stronger mindset, better management capabilities, and practical tools they can apply in everyday workplace situations.

Why Leaders Today Must Adopt a Coaching Mindset

Leadership is evolving from directive management to a coaching-centred approach grounded in research. Leaders who adopt this mindset do not merely "manage" employees; they architect environments that foster higher engagement and more open communication.

Instead of simply giving instructions, these leaders develop other employees through active listening, powerful questioning, and constructive feedback. Our coaching workshop equips leaders with these essential competencies through real workplace scenarios, and guided practice that can be immediately applied on the job.

Designed for Leaders and Managers Who Want to Lead with Impact

  • Develop a coaching mindset by integrating coaching competencies into managerial roles. This workshop is ideal for emerging leaders, mid-level managers, senior leaders, and HR or L&D professionals responsible for guiding teams and driving organizational growth.
  • Beyond theory, this hands-on course for leaders and managers provides real-world coaching applications, case studies, and expert guidance that prepare them to become Coaching-Leaders. The skills learned in this workshop are especially valuable for improving team performance, navigating change management, and enhancing day-to-day communication and collaboration.

By completing this coaching workshop, your organization can enhance its leadership capabilities and earn a recognition certification - Certified Coaching-Leader, positioning them as a forward-thinking leader who drives measurable success.

Become a Certified Coaching Leader - Elevate Your Leadership Practice

Strengthen Your Organization’s Coaching Culture and Capability

As the pace of business quickens and competition stiffens, organizations and their leaders continue to ask, "how can we achieve a significant and sustainable competitive advantage?"

The world's top-performing companies recognize that developing leaders in coaching is a key driver of organizational success. Training leaders in coaching builds a culture of continuous learning, enhances team performance, improves communication, and increases employee engagement and retention. Engaged employees are committed to the organization's success, willing to go the extra mile, more productive, and stay longer with the organization.

"The best companies now know, without a doubt, where productivity comes from.It comes from challenged, empowered, excited, and rewarded teams. It comes from engaging every single mind in the organisation, making everyone part of the action, and allowing everyone to have a voice - a role – in the success of the enterprise. Doing so raises productivity, not incrementally, but by multiples."Jack Welch, former CEO and Chairman, General Electric

As complexity continues to infiltrate every aspect of the organization, leaders trained in coaching through our workshops ensure people work more effectively and efficiently, enabling the organization to achieve measurable business results and maintain a competitive edge.

What You Will Learn in This Coaching Workshop

What makes this workshop truly unique is that it offers leaders the opportunity to develop coaching competencies traditionally reserved for professional coaching certification. As an ICF-accredited coach training program, this course is part of a professional coaching certification pathway, meaning leaders and managers can now gain the same level of coaching proficiency as those training to become professional coaches.

This isn't just a leadership training program but also a transformational experience that empowers leaders to think like a professional coach when leading their team, elevating their ability to inspire, guide, and drive meaningful change.

By completing this workshop, leaders develop a coaching mindset and integrate coaching competencies into their leadership and managerial roles. Key topics and skills covered include:

  • Coaching Mindset: Cultivating the curiosity and self-awareness required to lead with intention.
  • Practical Coaching Tools: Applying frameworks like Awareness-Clarity-Choice to guide problem-solving, decision-making, and team development.
  • Empathy and Emotional Intelligence (EQ): Navigating the emotions of the "protective mind" to promote psychological safety.
  • Feedback Conversations: Delivering high-stakes feedback that motivates vertical growth.
  • Conflict Navigation: Navigating "threshold" conversations to turn friction into collaborative opportunity.
  • ICF Core Competencies Application: Maintaining the professional rigor and ethical boundaries of a master practitioner.

The good news is that we have expertise in advanced instructional design to customize the learning to fit your organization’s culture or learning goals, helping to boost your organization’s coaching capacity and drive measurable impact across teams.

Why “Leading with Impact” is Essential for Your Leadership Development Program

“Leading with Impact” is a crucial component of any leadership development program because it equips managers with the coaching skills needed to succeed in today’s evolving workplace.

By learning to coach, managers become leaders who can engage, inspire, and positively influence their teams. As a result, this shift strengthens talent management, boosts learning agility, and drives higher levels of performance across individuals and teams. In a workforce that values connection, empowerment, and growth, coaching becomes an essential people skill for effective leadership.

Moreover, this workshop focuses on practical coaching techniques that help leaders ask the questions that uncover root causes, spark insight, and drive ownership. By adopting a coaching style over a directive approach, leaders build stronger engagement and accountability, leading to improved productivity and better business outcomes. These capabilities clearly set highly effective leaders apart from average managers.

Built on a proprietary transformational coaching approach and supported by the science of positive leadership, this workshop provides leaders with a facilitative framework that encourages better thinking and meaningful development. Over time, this training leads to sustainable behavior change, stronger performance management, and long-term organizational success, highlighting that coaching is a key driver of modern leadership effectiveness.

Organizational Benefits: From Engagement to Performance

It is people, not organizational structures or systems, that drive growth. Hence, leaders and managers need to master skills that inspire commitment and accountability.

As Stephen Denning highlights in "The Secret Language of Leadership", leaders create impact by generating enthusiasm and communicating in ways that truly resonate. In this context, the coaching workshop becomes more than a methodology or trend. It is a leadership approach that strengthens how leaders connect, communicate, and motivate, making training more impactful and results-driven.

Organizations that institutionalize this level of coaching see stronger team cohesion, higher engagement, and fewer interpersonal conflicts. Because coaching conversations encourage employees to think through challenges rather than just follow instructions, they develop ownership and problem-solving ability.

This leads to improved productivity, more consistent performance, and a stronger leadership pipeline as emerging leaders step up with confidence.

Coaching in Action - Practice, Feedback & Real-World Application

To ensure learning translates into real workplace impact, this workshop emphasizes hands-on practice and real coaching conversations. Leaders engage in structured role-plays, peer-coaching exercises, and guided practice sessions that mirror real leadership scenarios.

Learners also receive constructive feedback from facilitators and peers, helping them refine their communication style, questioning techniques, and listening skills. Leaders leave with the confidence to immediately apply these approaches, ensuring sustainable behavior change and stronger leadership performance.

Flexible Delivery Options – Online and Hybrid Workshops

Our coaching workshop is designed for maximum flexibility to suit your organization’s needs, offering online and hybrid sessions that fit easily into your schedule.

To make participation even more convenient for geographically dispersed teams, our monthly training calendar automatically converts session times to your local time zone, so you can join when it works best for you.
